from tslearn.early_classification import NonMyopicEarlyClassifier
from tslearn.utils import to_time_series_dataset, to_time_series
import numpy as np

X_train = to_time_series_dataset([[1, 2], [1, 2], [3, 4], [3, 4]])
y_train = [0, 0, 1, 1]

model = NonMyopicEarlyClassifier(n_clusters=2, lamb=1.0, random_state=0)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

partial_ts = to_time_series([1])
probas = model.get_cluster_probas(partial_ts)

assert probas.shape == (2,), f"Expected shape (2,), got {probas.shape}"
assert np.isclose(np.sum(probas), 1.0), f"Expected sum 1.0, got {np.sum(probas)}"
print(f"__CHECK__ get_cluster_probas {probas.shape} {np.sum(probas)}")
